boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented NYU gatherings and recurring practices, from a giant strawberry shortcake to an all-university read.

cards.title: UltraViolet Live
cards.subtitle: NYU’s annual student talent final
cards.notes: Watch for preliminary rounds in residence halls and student communities, then catch the finalists performing at the Skirball Center.
cards.short_summary: A campuswide talent competition culminating in a live Skirball performance.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes UltraViolet Live as an annual competition in which student performers advance from preliminary rounds to a Skirball Center final.
cards.access_notes: Check NYU event listings for the current year’s preliminary and final-round details.

cards.title: IHRC Flurry
cards.subtitle: Annual NYU ice-skating gathering in Central Park
cards.notes: Look for the Inter-Residence Hall Council’s winter announcement and join the scheduled skating session with NYU community members.
cards.short_summary: A recurring NYU winter outing built around ice skating, music, and seasonal treats.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU identifies Flurry as an annual Inter-Residence Hall Council event in Central Park that brings together NYU community members for ice skating and activities.
cards.access_notes: Event timing, registration, and any participation requirements vary by year.

cards.title: NYU Strawberry Festival
cards.subtitle: Washington Square campus street fair and giant shortcake
cards.notes: Stop by the Washington Square campus fair to see the oversized strawberry shortcake alongside music, games, and campus booths.
cards.short_summary: A long-running spring festival centered on a famously large strawberry shortcake.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU says its Strawberry Festival is a campus tradition featuring a giant strawberry shortcake, live music, carnival games, giveaways, and interactive booths.
cards.access_notes: NYU’s 2023 tradition guide states the festival is free for NYU students and the public.

cards.title: NYU Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: The annual start-of-semester welcome program
cards.notes: Use the Welcome Week schedule to choose a few low-pressure events that help you learn campus neighborhoods and meet new people.
cards.short_summary: A recurring fall welcome program that marks the start of the NYU experience.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes Welcome Week as an annual fall tradition with events and programs that introduce students to the University community.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Welcome Week schedule; individual events and attendance rules vary.

cards.title: Reality Show: NYU
cards.subtitle: Student-written Welcome Week musical
cards.notes: Attend the Welcome Week performance to see students turn first-year life into comedic sketches and original songs.
cards.short_summary: A student-produced musical that is part of NYU’s Welcome Week programming.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU documents Reality Show: NYU as a Welcome Week musical written, performed, and produced by NYU students.
cards.source_title: Top NYU Traditions to Take Advantage Of
cards.access_notes: Check the current Welcome Week program for venue, date, and attendance information.

cards.title: NYU Club Fest
cards.subtitle: Student-organization gathering at the Paulson Center
cards.notes: Bring a short list of interests, then speak with organization members and save follow-up information for groups you want to explore.
cards.short_summary: A recurring in-person showcase connecting NYU students with student-run organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU calls Club Fest an annual event where students engage in person with more than 300 student-run organizations.
cards.access_notes: NYU identifies the Paulson Center as the event location; confirm the current semester’s details.

cards.title: NYU Reads
cards.subtitle: University-wide shared book selection
cards.notes: Pick up or borrow the selected title, then watch for related discussions that connect the book to the NYU community.
cards.short_summary: A shared-reading tradition that centers a single book and campus conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU states that NYU Reads selects a book of the year through a faculty, student, and staff committee to foster University-wide conversation.
cards.access_notes: The selected book and discussion opportunities change annually; check the NYU Reads announcement.

cards.title: NYU MLK Week
cards.subtitle: Annual February commemoration of Dr. King’s NYU visit
cards.notes: Review the February program and choose a reflective, educational, or community-building event that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: An annual NYU commemoration connecting Dr. King’s 1961 visit with present-day programming.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU says MLK Week commemorates Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s 1961 visit to University Heights through February events.
cards.access_notes: Programming is held annually in February; verify the current schedule and accessibility details.

cards.title: NYU In Dialogue
cards.subtitle: Ongoing campus conversation series
cards.notes: Choose a session whose topic interests you and arrive ready to listen, reflect, and participate within the event’s stated format.
cards.short_summary: An NYU series that uses stories and dialogue to build empathy and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU describes the NYU In Dialogue Event Series as an ongoing program focused on fostering empathy through stories and dialogue.
cards.access_notes: Session topics, dates, and participation arrangements are announced separately.

cards.title: Commencement at Yankee Stadium
cards.subtitle: NYU’s university-wide graduation ceremony
cards.notes: Graduating students should use NYU’s official commencement information for ceremony requirements, guest guidance, and current logistics.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide graduation tradition staged at Yankee Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU’s tradition guide describes its commencement celebration at Yankee Stadium and notes an honorary degree recipient addresses the graduating class.
cards.source_title: Top NYU Traditions to Take Advantage Of
cards.access_notes: Eligibility, tickets, venue procedures, and the program are set through the current NYU commencement office.
